en: A color postcard showing a busy outdoor café terrace filled with people seated closely together under tall closed yellow umbrellas. Leafless trees stand among the tables, and in the background are brick and glass buildings with shop and bar signs, including a circular Heineken sign. The image is framed with a colored border on a white card, and the word 'Nijmegen' is printed below the picture.
